pages.title: Proof by Induction
pages.text: $(thing)Proof by Induction$()$(br2)Show it for the first case, and show that each case gives the next: then it holds for all of them, like dominoes. Unlocks the Proof Certificate.

$(thing)Insight$(): 25$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Formal Logic.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Axiom Schema.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Write the sum S of the first n squares, 1 + 4 + 9 + ... + n², the formula that induction proves.
